title: WaterSound Crossings A-323 - 429 Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- 3 Adult Bikes- Dedicated garage parking space- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property comes with 1 designated parking space and 1 first-come first-serve parking space. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.LOCATION: This home is just a few steps from the beach access. DETAILS: The impeccable location, unobstructed coastal views and modern design of this condominium make this unit the perfect getaway for your party. Located right on the beach in Watersound's Crossings District, this 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath, condo sits just steps from the beach. The 180 degree panoramic views, soaked in from the second dining table and additional seating area, on this deck-sized" balcony sets this unit over the top. Upon entering the home, you are greeted by the living and dining areas with ample space to sit and enjoy each other's company with the sea's breeze filtering in from the coastal doors. There are club chairs, a couch, a chaise lounge, and an additional cushioned chair in the living area. The beautiful dining room table seats 8 comfortably on its large bench and 5 chairs. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances and black granite countertops. There is also a half bath located near the front door. The Master Suite can be found on the East wing of the condominium. In the bedroom, there is a king bed, club chairs, a TV, and an access way to the magnificent deck. Across the hall, and after passing Moby, the home's fish mascot, is the sophisticated master bath. It has a double vanity, walk-in shower, jetted tub, two very large mirrors, and two large walk-in closets. The other bedrooms can be found on the West Wing of the condominium. The first of which has a king bed, an additional access point to the spacious balcony, and a connecting bath with a single vanity and shower-tub combo. Across the hall, the third and final bedroom has two double beds and a connecting bath with a single vanity and shower-tub combo. There is also a bonus office space in the hallway between these two bedrooms.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR: - Master Bedroom: King Bed, Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Double Beds, Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboAMENITIES INCLUDE: Community Pool, Gulf Views, and 1 parking spot. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. IMPORTANT INFORMATION *HOA regulations do not allow for guest Low-Speed Vehicle rentals. Additionally, bringing your own Low-Speed Vehicle onto the property is prohibited.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.* Pets are not permitted on the property. Any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.
